about: Shared period policy of ClaView A (user decisions of 2026-10-20; policy ① of 2026-10-30 for anchor_rule). Frequencies longest first; default_recent_years is the window assumed when a question names no period. anchor_rule: what a relative or open period counts from (as_of_calendar: the period as_of falls in; data_latest: the table's or the bundle's latest data, the rule before). condition_rule (policy ②④, plan 56 order 5): with no period or no frequency to go on, ask_condition asks the user and applies no default; resolver_default is the rule before (default_recent_years and the resolver's frequency default).
